instruction: Courtyard starter house from scratch. In Archicad, create a new one-storey courtyard starter house using real BIM elements, not proxy or purely visual placeholder geometry, for the building storey, IfcSpace zones, walls, slabs or roof enclosure, and courtyard area. Save an IFC4 export to C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc and export a real tab-delimited zone schedule to C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.txt. The IFC model must contain exactly one IfcBuildingStorey, exactly eight IfcSpace zones placed on that storey, at least eight wall elements, at least one roof element, and unique IFC GlobalId values for exported root objects. Assign the zone number as the space Reference or LongName where the exporter supports it. The required zones and target areas are Z01 ENTRY 9.0 m2, Z02 LIVING-DINING 24.0 m2, Z03 KITCHEN 9.0 m2, Z04 BED-1 12.0 m2, Z05 BED-2 12.0 m2, Z06 BATH 4.0 m2, Z07 LAUNDRY 3.0 m2, and Z08 COURTYARD 18.0 m2. Each listed area must be within +/-0.10 m2; the courtyard must be between 14.0 and 24.0 m2, each bedroom between 8.0 and 16.0 m2, and the combined indoor area of all non-courtyard zones between 65.0 and 110.0 m2. The schedule must use the headers ZoneNumber, ZoneName, Area and list the eight zones in the same order as above, with schedule areas matching the IFC space quantities within +/-0.10 m2. Harmless exporter-generated metadata, materials, property sets, relationships, and additional non-required helper objects may vary as long as the required BIM elements and spaces are present. [Software] Launch ArchiCAD with `C:\Program Files\Graphisoft\Archicad 27\Archicad` (adjust version/path).
